# Watchlist brief: 2026-10-19

*Sample data for the test environment: prices and news are simulated.*

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 0.28% (z-score 0.4). Strongest sector: Technology (XLK) +1.38%; weakest: Consumer Staples (XLP) -0.12%.

## Notable moves

### MSFT: +4.98% (z-score 2.35, volume 3.0x normal)
- **What happened:** MSFT moved +4.98% on volume 3.0x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** MSFT rose 4.98%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 1.38% and the S&P 500 rose 0.28%. That is 3.59 points better than its sector, an unusual gap for MSFT (z-score 2.2), so the move looks specific to MSFT.
- **Likely why:** Quarterly results beat expectations and guidance was raised. [Demo Markets Daily](https://news.example.com/2026-10-19/msft-earnings)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

AAPL (+3.14%), NVDA (+2.38%), AMZN (-0.39%), JPM (+0.49%)

## Coming up

- Mon Oct 19: Microsoft (MSFT): Earnings report
- Wed Oct 21: NVIDIA (NVDA): Product launch event
